members.name: getSpecialEditorForType

type.text: (property: IProperty, currentValue: any, propertyPath: string, wbRender: WbRenderEventType, additionalInfo?: any) => Promise<HTMLElement | null>

members.description: JavaScript-only async editor replacement hook, including array/dictionary collections; null retains default fallback. Supports pre-upgrade assignment; stale async results are ignored. Not automatically copied into collection draft grids. Commit replacements through setPropertyValue.

members.name: additionalStyleSheets
members.description: JavaScript-only per-instance constructed sheets adopted after built-in sheets. Assignment and retrieval defensively copy the list; native adoption errors surface. Supports pre-upgrade assignment.

members.name: rowHeight
members.description: Fixed row height in CSS pixels. Finite numbers >= 4 only; invalid assignments throw RangeError and retain the previous value. Synchronizes numeric/CSS geometry, scrolling the retained focused row into the updated viewport before virtualization; preserves pending editing and feedback classes across resize. Supports pre-upgrade assignment.

members.name: nameColumnRatio
members.description: Finite relative name-column share strictly between 0 and 1; invalid assignments throw RangeError and retain state. Updates numeric weights, clears dragged custom widths and resizes without rebuilding editors; retains row/cell validation feedback. Supports pre-upgrade assignment.

members.name: showHead
members.description: Live type-name header visibility; updates display without refresh and scrolls the retained focused row into the resized viewport before virtualization. Supports pre-upgrade assignment.

members.name: showDescription
members.description: Live description visibility; updates display without refresh and scrolls the retained focused row into the resized viewport before virtualization. Supports pre-upgrade assignment. Use the property to hide the default-visible region.

attributes.name: name-column-ratio
attributes.description: Initial decimal parseFloat value at readiness, default 0.5; must be finite and strictly between 0 and 1. Overrides pre-readiness assignments. Later attribute changes are not reactive; use nameColumnRatio live.

attributes.name: show-head
attributes.description: Initial presence-based Boolean (even false text means true), default false. Overrides pre-readiness assignment; use showHead live.

attributes.name: show-description
attributes.description: Initial presence-based Boolean (even false text means true), default true. Overrides pre-readiness assignment; use showDescription = false to hide, or the property for live changes.

attributes.name: row-height
attributes.description: Initial height at readiness, default 22px, parsed once with decimal parseFloat: 28px/28malformed means 28; 0x20 parses as 0 and is rejected without changing state. Results must be finite and >= 4. Takes precedence over pre-readiness property assignment. Use rowHeight for live changes; later attribute changes are not reactive.

cssProperties.name: --pg-row-separator-color

cssProperties.name: --pg-cell-separator-color
cssProperties.description: Opt-in native grid-cell right border color; requires inherited CSS style-query support. Missing tokens preserve original last-cell behavior; validation/error/busy feedback excluded

cssProperties.name: --pg-cell-separator-style
